notes: Statistics Centre Abu Dhabi (SCAD) publishes population only at the Abu Dhabi Emirate's three top-level regions (Abu Dhabi Region, Al Ain Region, Al Dhafra Region) — no finer public breakdown exists. Abu Dhabi Region's entire 2024 register-based population figure is applied as a single figure, then re-split into a synthetic ~5km grid (our own construction) to restore distance-decay in the gravity model. No real employment data exists: jobs are a flat 40% of resident population, redistributed across OSM buildings weighted by floor area only. Commute flows are an unconstrained gravity model with no real O/D anchor. The Zayed International Airport special point's passenger figure does use a real, sourced correspondence/transfer-passenger split (47.5% origin-destination, from Abu Dhabi Airports' own Q3 2024 report) rather than raw total traffic, but this is one small special point, not a characterization of the map's overall workplace/resident/O-D methodology.
